citizen.name: Zeph Tide
citizen.learned: Zeph grew up in a coastal village and learned to read the tides from his grandmother.
citizen.lifestyle: Zeph spends most of his time near the water, studying the ebb and flow of the tides.
citizen.currently: Zeph is curious about the recent changes in the tidal patterns and is determined to understand their cause.

relationships: Zeph and Coral often discuss the tides and share their observations.
Zeph and Caspian have been friends since childhood and often work together.
